### Royal Ribbon (G4)

Royal Ribbon is the **pink unicorn with a curled blue-and-pale-blue mane, lavender eyes, and a lilac bow and decorative saddle** who mingles with Canterlot’s well-dressed crowds. She is a recurring *Friendship is Magic* background mare, especially recognizable at fashion shows and the Grand Galloping Gala. Her brief on-screen cutie mark resembles a **scroll**; her toy instead carries a **ribbon**. [Character and episode reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Royal_Ribbon)

**Name and continuity:** Never named aloud in the G4 show; **Royal Ribbon** is an official merchandise/game name, with a [G4 Fashion Style release](https://data.mlpmerch.com/brushables/pony/royal-ribbon/). A *different* G3 Earth pony already used the name in a [2004 dress-up toy](https://mylittlewiki.org/wiki/Royal_Ribbon); their shared name does not establish a shared continuity or identity.

**Voice:** Not silent—she has **three brief lines**, two at Photo Finish’s show in **“Green Isn’t Your Color”** and one in **“Princess Twilight Sparkle – Part 1”** (“Princess Twilight will know!”). The English voice performer is not securely identified; the character reference lists **Ikumi Nakagami** for the Japanese dub.

**Where to spot her:** **“The Ticket Master,” “The Best Night Ever,” “Sweet and Elite,” “A Canterlot Wedding,” “Rarity Takes Manehattan,”** and later Canterlot scenes. She also appears in **IDW *Friendship is Magic* #5** and ***Ponyville Mysteries* #5**. The [licensed mobile game’s profile](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Royal_Ribbon) portrays her as a self-described stylist; that characterization comes from the game, not an on-screen profession.
